in_sanskrit.name: हर्पालसिंह
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is protected by Lord Vishnu, like a lion.

in_hindi.name: हर्पालसिंह
in_hindi.long_meaning: विष्णु के पास से पत्रकारी हुआ शिंशापा, जैसे शिंशापा के साथ है सिंह (Lion).

in_marathi.name: Harpalsinh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harpalsinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harpalsinh is a compound name derived from Sanskrit words 'Har' and 'Palsinh'. 'Har' refers to Lord Shiva, while 'Palsinh' translates to 'messenger' or 'messenger of God'. This name is given to a child believed to be a divine messenger.
